items.text: Bills WR DJ Moore is inactive (shoulder, was Q); Josh Palmer is active.
items.why: Shoulder; returned to practice Friday but inactive.
items.implication: Late confirmation removes volume from BUF WR corps; Palmer steps in.
items.opportunity: Increased snaps/targets for remaining Bills WRs including Palmer.

items.text: Colts TE Tyler Warren is inactive today (groin, was Q/GTD).
items.implication: Surprising miss; streamer TE needed. Boosts other Colts pass-catchers.
items.opportunity: Josh Downs and remaining TEs see target uptick; Juwan Johnson etc. as streamers per Berry.

items.text: Browns RB Quinshon Judkins (ankle, was Q) is inactive/out today vs Ravens after pregame workout.
items.why: Ankle; only one limited practice, failed pregame workout threshold.
items.implication: Browns RB depth thins to Jaleel McLaughlin and Audric Estime only; Judkins misses first game of season.
items.opportunity: Backups see all carries/snaps in tough matchup; low-upside flex only.

items.text: Actives include Caleb Williams, Rico Dowdle, Chris Olave, Alvin Kamara, Kenyon Sadiq, Ja’Kobi Lane. Inactives Judkins/Warren confirmed.
items.why: Cleared as expected from ETR/Schefter/Rapoport reports.
items.implication: Full go for key fantasy pieces; reverse any prior sit concerns.
items.opportunity: Normal/high snap shares resume (Kamara/Olave usage, Williams QB, Dowdle committee).

items.text: Patriots TreVeyon Henderson and AJ Brown both officially active (were likely/Q); NE near full health.
items.why: Ankle issues cleared; AJB activated to 53 prior.
items.implication: Full offense available vs Jets; Henderson role + Brown targets.
items.opportunity: Henderson carries/routes; Brown WR1 volume in return.

items.text: Whoa on Warren inactive; Juwan Johnson, Freiermuth and Higbee among favorite streamer TEs.
items.why: Warren surprise inactive opens TE streaming.
items.implication: Pivot to listed streamers for Week 6.
items.opportunity: Target share to remaining IND options + streamers.

items.text: Titans RB Tyjae Spears is active today (was Q).
items.implication: Titans RB committee intact; pairs with Warren inactive news for IND-TEN game.

items.text: Updated ranks: Cam Skattebo RB28 (still start for explosiveness/TD chance vs NO but riskier flex post-rotation), Najee Harris RB33. Prefer Najee over DK sometimes in PPR TD spots.
items.why: Rotation change after fumbles; still likes upside vs NO but pre-season hate validated.
items.implication: Flex not locked RB2; monitor actual split.
items.conflict: Levitan data on YOE/fumbles supports caution more than pure start.

items.text: Cam Skattebo currently 37th/43 RBs in rush yards over expected + 4 fumbles (1 lost). Giants expected to change RB rotation; Najee Harris larger role, Skattebo downgraded but still mixed in. All 4 RBs active.
items.why: Poor efficiency + fumbles; beat sources confirm rotation change.
items.implication: Riskier flex/RB2; explosiveness still gives TD chance vs NO per Berry but volume split.
items.opportunity: Najee Harris role expansion; Tracy/Singletary involved.
items.conflict: Berry still prefers starting Skattebo over pure Najee for upside but ranks RB28 riskier flex.

items.text: Weekend summary: GTD Judkins/Warren/Evans/Kirk; Expected Caleb/Olave/Kamara/AJB/Henderson/Metcalf/Freiermuth/Sadiq; Not expected Deebo/Croskey-Merritt/Tucker; Activated Jaydon Blue. Later updates flipped Judkins/Warren to out.
items.why: Compiled weekend reports; projections hub updated.
items.implication: Core status tracker for AM; last-min show schedule for changes.
items.opportunity: Monitor beneficiaries on outs; expected play = full roles.

items.text: Saints Alvin Kamara (back) and Chris Olave (illness) both Q but expected to play; later confirmed active.
items.why: Sources confirm expected; Schefter actives list.
items.implication: Full roles vs Giants; no reverse beneficiaries.

items.text: No news yet early on DJ Moore/Josh Palmer/Tyjae Spears; projections updated for all news at ETR hub. Later confirmed Judkins/Warren outs + Spears active + Moore inactive.
items.why: Real-time injury integration into DFS/season-long projs.
items.implication: Use updated numbers for late lineup locks.

items.text: Deebo Samuel not expected to play.
Eagles placed QB Jalen Hurts on IR; signed RB Jaydon Blue to active roster. (Prior to Sunday.)
items.implication: Tanner McKee starts; Blue adds RB depth (Barkley uncertain prior).

items.text: Loves: Mike Evans (WR4 vs WSH), Drake London (WR6 vs CHI), George Kittle (TE3 vs WSH), Kyren Williams (RB5 vs ARI), Javonte Williams (RB8 @GB), Rhamondre Stevenson (RB9 vs NYJ), Brock Purdy (QB2 vs WSH). Soft matchups + volume/usage.
items.why: WSH buffet for pass catchers; elite usage/leaking run Ds; high-scoring environments.
items.implication: Strong start signals; goal-line for Javonte, volume for Kyren/Rhamondre.

items.text: Hates: Jaylen Waddle (WR28 vs SEA), Emeka Egbuka (WR34 vs PIT), Kyle Pitts (TE18 vs CHI), J.K. Dobbins (RB27 vs SEA), Bo Nix (QB23 vs SEA), Justin Herbert (QB25 @KC). Ugly matchups + shaky QB/usage.
items.why: Tough Ds (SEA especially), recent feed struggles, low totals.
